items.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ سَبَّحَكَ وَقَدَّسَكَ وَسَجَدَ لَكَ وَعَظَّمَكَ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ خَلَقْتَهُمْ فِيهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ.
items.en: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family as many as those who glorified You, sanctified You, prostrated to You, and magnified You, and as many as every year You created them in, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the flowing clouds and the scattering winds.
items.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi 'adada man sabbahaka wa qaddasaka wa sajada laka wa 'azzamak, wa 'adada kulli sanatin khalaqtahum fiha, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa 'adadas-sahabil-jariyati war-riyahidh-dhariyah.

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَحَرَّكَتْ مِنَ الْأَغْصَانِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ وَالْأَوْرَاقِ وَالثِّمَارِ وَالْأَزْهَارِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ عَلَى قَرَارِ أَرْضِكَ وَمَا بَيْنَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَعَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ الْبِحَارِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: And as many as what the winds have stirred and moved of branches, trees, leaves, fruits, and flowers, and as many as what You created upon the settled part of Your earth and between Your heavens, and as many as the waves of the seas, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Wa 'adada ma habbat bihir-riyahu wa harrakat minal-aghsani wal-ashjari wal-awraqi wath-thimari wal-azhar, wa 'adada ma khalaqta 'ala qarari ardhika wa ma bayna samawatik, wa 'adada amwajil-bihar, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالْحَصَى وَكُلِّ حَجَرٍ وَمَدَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا سَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا، وَعَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ فِي قِبْلَتِهَا وَجَوْفِهَا وَشَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: And as many as the sand and pebbles and every stone and clod You created in the east and west of the earth, its plains, its mountains, and its valleys, and as many as the plants of the earth in its south and north, its east and west, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Wa 'adadar-ramli wal-hasa wa kulli hajarin wa madarin khalaqtahu fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha sahliha wa jibaliha wa awdiyatiha, wa 'adada nabatil-ardhi fi qiblatiha wa jawfiha wa sharqiha wa gharbiha, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

lessons.title: In Every Night and Every Day

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْإِنْسِ وَالْجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَوُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ، وَعَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَلَحَظَاتِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: And as many as what You created of humans, jinn, and devils, and what You will create of them until the Day of Resurrection, and as many as every hair on their bodies, their faces, and their heads, and as many as their breaths, their utterances, and their glances, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-insi wal-jinni wash-shayatini wa ma anta khaliquhu minhum ila yawmil-qiyamah, wa 'adada kulli sha'ratin fi abdanihim wa wujuhihim wa 'ala ru'usihim, wa 'adada anfasihim wa alfazihim wa lahazatihim, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَخَفَقَانِ الْإِنْسِ، وَعَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلَى أَرْضِكَ صَغِيرَةً أَوْ كَبِيرَةً فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا مِمَّا عُلِمَ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
items.en: And as many as the flight of jinn and the flapping of humans, and as many as every creature You created upon Your earth, small or large, in the east and west of the earth, of what is known and what none knows except You, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day.
items.translit: Wa 'adada tayaranil-jinni wa khafaqanil-ins, wa 'adada kulli bahimatin khalaqtaha 'ala ardhika saghiratan aw kabiratan fi mashariqil-ardhi wa magharibiha mimma 'ulima wa mimma la ya'lamu 'ilmahu illa ant, min yawmi khalaqtad-dunya ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah.

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَعَدَدَ الْأَحْيَاءِ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَعَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْحِيتَانِ وَالطَّيْرِ وَالنَّمْلِ وَالنَّحْلِ وَالْحَشَرَاتِ.
items.en: And as many as those who have blessed him and as many as those who have not blessed him and as many as those who will bless him until the Day of Resurrection, a thousand times every day, and as many as the living and the dead, and as many as what You created of fish, birds, ants, bees, and insects.
items.translit: Wa 'adada man salla 'alayhi wa 'adada man lam yusalli 'alayhi wa 'adada man yusalli 'alayhi ila yawmil-qiyamati fi kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa 'adadal-ahya'i wal-amwat, wa 'adada ma khalaqta minal-hitani wat-tayri wan-namli wan-nahli wal-hasharat.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى، مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا إِلَى أَنْ صَارَ كَهْلًا مَهْدِيًّا، فَقَبَضْتَهُ إِلَيْكَ عَدْلًا مَرْضِيًّا لِتَبْعَثَهُ شَفِيعًا حَفِيًّا.
items.en: And to send blessings upon him and upon his family in the night when it covers and the day when it appears in glory, and in the last life and the first, from when he was a child in the cradle until he became a guided elder, and You took him to You, a just and pleasing one, that You might raise him as a caring intercessor.
items.translit: Wa an tusalliya 'alayhi wa 'ala alihi fil-layli idha yaghsha wan-nahari idha tajalla, wa fil-akhirati wal-ula, mundhu kana fil-mahdi sabiyyan ila an sara kahlan mahdiyyan, fa-qabadhtahu ilayka 'adlan mardhiyyan li-tab'athahu shafi'an hafiyyan.

items.ar: وَعَدَدَ خَلْقِكَ وَرِضَا نَفْسِكَ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُؤْتِيَهُ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَالْحَوْضَ الْمَوْرُودَ وَالْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ وَالْعِزَّ الْمَمْدُودَ، وَأَنْ تُعَظِّمَ بُرْهَانَهُ وَتُشَرِّفَ بُنْيَانَهُ وَتَرْفَعَ مَكَانَهُ.
items.en: And as many as Your creation, and to the extent of Your own pleasure, and the weight of Your Throne, and the ink of Your words, and to grant him the wasila, the excellence, the elevated rank, the frequented Pool, the Praised Station, and the extended honor, and to magnify his proof, honor his structure, and raise his standing.
items.translit: Wa 'adada khalqika wa ridha'a nafsika wa zinata 'arshika wa midada kalimatik, wa an tu'tiyahul-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata wal-hawdhal-mawruda wal-maqamal-mahmuda wal-'izzal-mamdud, wa an tu'azzima burhanahu wa tusharrifa bunyanahu wa tarfa'a makanahu.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تَسْتَعْمِلَنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا بِسُنَّتِهِ وَتُمِيتَنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَأَنْ تَحْشُرَنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَأَنْ تَجْعَلَنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، وَأَنْ تُورِدَنَا حَوْضَهُ وَتَسْقِيَنَا بِكَأْسِهِ وَتَنْفَعَنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ.
items.en: And to employ us, O our Protector, by his way, and to take our souls upon his religion, and to gather us in his company and beneath his banner, and to make us among his companions, and to bring us to his Pool, give us to drink from his cup, and benefit us through love of him.
items.translit: Wa an tasta'milana ya Mawlana bi-sunnatihi wa tumitana 'ala millatih, wa an tahshurana fi zumratihi wa tahta liwa'ih, wa an taj'alana min rufaqa'ih, wa an turidana hawdhahu wa tasqiyana bika'sihi wa tanfa'ana bi-mahabbatih.

items.ar: وَأَنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيْنَا وَتُعَافِيَنَا مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَى وَالْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ، وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنَا وَتَعْفُوَ عَنَّا، وَتَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَلِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
items.en: And to accept our repentance and grant us well-being from every trial and affliction and tribulation, what is apparent of it and what is hidden, and to have mercy on us and pardon us, and forgive us and all the believing men and women and Muslim men and women, the living among them and the dead, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
items.translit: Wa an tatuba 'alayna wa tu'afiyana min jami'il-bala'i wal-balwa wal-fitani ma zahara minha wa ma batan, wa an tarhamana wa ta'fuwa 'anna, wa taghfira lana wa li-jami'il-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimatil-ahya'i minhum wal-amwat, wal-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin.

items.ar: وَهُوَ حَسْبِي وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
items.en: And He is sufficient for me, and the best Disposer of affairs. And there is no power and no might except in Allah, the Most High, the Exalted.
items.translit: Wa huwa hasbi wa ni'mal-wakil, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim.

lessons.title: For as Long as the Doves Coo

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا سَجَعَتِ الْحَمَائِمُ وَهَمَتِ الْهَوَامِعُ وَسَرَحَتِ الْبَهَائِمُ وَنَفَعَتِ التَّمَائِمُ وَاشْتَدَّتِ الْعَمَائِمُ وَنَامَتِ النَّوَائِمُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the doves coo, the pouring rains fall, the grazing beasts roam, the amulets bring benefit, the turbans are wound tight, and the sleepers sleep.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin ma saja'atil-hama'imu wa hamatil-hawami'u wa sarahatil-baha'imu wa nafa'atit-tama'imu wash-taddatil-'aza'imu wa namatin-nawa'im.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا أَبْلَجَ الصَّبَاحُ وَهَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ وَدَبَّتِ الْأَشْبَاحُ وَتَعَاقَبَ الْغُدُوُّ وَالرَّوَاحُ، وَصَحَّتِ الْأَجْسَادُ وَالْأَرْوَاحُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the morning dawns, the winds blow, living beings move, morning and evening succeed one another, and bodies and souls are sound.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin ma ablajas-sabahu wa habbatir-riyahu wa dabbatil-ashbahu wa ta'aqabal-ghuduwwu war-rawahu, wa sahhatil-ajsadu wal-arwah.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا دَارَتِ الْأَفْلَاكُ وَدَرَجَتِ الْأَحْلَاكُ وَسَبَّحَتِ الْمَلَائِكُ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad, for as long as the celestial spheres turn, generations pass on, and the angels glorify.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin ma daratil-aflaku wa darajatil-ahlaku wa sabbahatil-mala'ik.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad and upon the family of our master Muhammad just as You sent blessings upon our master Ibrahim, and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad just as You blessed our master Ibrahim, in all the worlds. You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima, wa barik 'ala Sayyidina Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Sayyidina Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Sayyidina Ibrahima fil-'alamina, innaka Hamidun Majid.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا قَامَ بِأَعْبَاءِ الرِّسَالَةِ وَاسْتَنْقَذَ الْخَلْقَ مِنَ الْجَهَالَةِ وَجَاهَدَ أَهْلَ الْكُفْرِ وَالضَّلَالَةِ وَدَعَا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ وَقَاسَى الشَّدَائِدَ فِي إِرْشَادِ عَبِيدِكَ، فَآتِهِ اللَّهُمَّ سُؤْلَهُ وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ، وَآتِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ.
items.en: O Allah, just as he bore the burdens of the message, saved creation from ignorance, strove against the people of disbelief and misguidance, called to Your Oneness, and endured hardships in guiding Your servants, so grant him, O Allah, his request, and bring him to what he hopes for, and grant him the wasila, the excellence, and the elevated rank, and raise him to the Praised Station which You promised him. Indeed You do not break Your promise.
items.translit: Allahumma kama qama bi-a'ba'ir-risalati wastanqazal-khalqa minal-jahalati wa jahada ahlal-kufri wadh-dhalalati wa da'a ila tawhidika wa qasash-shada'ida fi irshadi 'abidik, fa-atihillahumma su'lahu wa balligh-hu ma'mulahu, wa atihil-wasilata wal-fadhilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ah, wab'athul-maqamal-mahmudal-ladhi wa'adtahu, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُتَّبِعِينَ لِشَرِيعَتِهِ الْمُتَّصِفِينَ بِمَحَبَّتِهِ الْمُهْتَدِينَ بِهَدْيِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا فَضْلَ شَفَاعَتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي أَتْبَاعِهِ الْغُرِّ الْمُحَجَّلِينَ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ السَّابِقِينَ وَأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, make us among the followers of his law, characterized by love of him, guided by his guidance, and take our souls upon his way, and do not deprive us of the grace of his intercession, and gather us among his radiant followers and his foremost adherents and the companions of the right hand, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.translit: Allahummaj'alna minal-muttabi'ina li-shari'atihil-muttasifina bi-mahabbatihil-muhtadina bi-hadyih, wa tawaffana 'ala sunnatih, wa la tahrimna fadhla shafa'atih, wahshurna fi atba'ihil-ghurril-muhajjalina wa ashya'ihis-sabiqina wa ashabil-yamin, ya arhamar-rahimin.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ وَعَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْمَرْحُومِينَ.
items.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Your angels brought near, and upon Your prophets and messengers, and upon all the people of Your obedience, and make us, through sending blessings upon them, among those shown mercy.
items.translit: Allahumma salli 'ala mala'ikatikal-muqarrabina wa 'ala anbiya'ika wal-mursalina wa 'ala ahli ta'atika ajma'in, waj'alna bis-salati 'alayhim minal-marhumin.
